CREATE TABLE "public"."AlertDeliveryClaim" (
  "alertId" text NOT NULL,
  "autoCleanup" bool NOT NULL,
  "channelId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "finalized" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "guildId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "messageId" text,
  CONSTRAINT "AlertDeliveryClaim_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AlertDestination" (
  "autoCleanup" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "channelId" text NOT NULL,
  "countyId" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz(3),
  "guildId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "latitude" text NOT NULL,
  "longitude" text NOT NULL,
  "radarImageUrl" text,
  "snowflake" text NOT NULL,
  "zoneId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "AlertDestination_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Announcement" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "snowflake" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Announcement_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AnnouncementDelivery" (
  "announcementId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "attemptCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "error" text,
  "failedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nextAttemptAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "sentAt" timestamptz(3),
  "subscriptionId" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "AnnouncementDelivery_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AnnouncementSubscription" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "AnnouncementSubscription_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AutoRadarMessage" (
  "channelId" text NOT NULL,
  "guildId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "location" text NOT NULL,
  "messageId" text NOT NULL,
  "nextUpdate" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "radarImageUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "radarStation" text NOT NULL,
  "showReflectivity" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "showVelocity" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "snowflake" text NOT NULL,
  "updateInterval" text DEFAULT '5m' NOT NULL,
  "velocityRadarImageUrl" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "AutoRadarMessage_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."EarthquakeDelivery" (
  "attemptCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "claimExpiresAt" timestamptz(3),
  "claimToken" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deliveredAt" timestamptz(3),
  "deliveredRevisionAt" timestamptz(3),
  "error" text,
  "eventId" text NOT NULL,
  "failedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "firstEligibleAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "lastEligible" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "messageId" text,
  "nextAttemptAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "state" "EarthquakeDeliveryState" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"EarthquakeDeliveryState" NOT NULL,
  "subscriptionId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "EarthquakeDelivery_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."EarthquakeEvent" (
  "depthKm" float8 NOT NULL,
  "detailUrl" text,
  "eventTime" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "eventType" text,
  "felt" int4,
  "firstObservedAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastObservedAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "longitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "magnitude" float8,
  "magnitudeType" text,
  "place" text,
  "productMetadata" text,
  "significance" int4,
  "sourceUpdatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "status" text,
  "tsunami" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "EarthquakeEvent_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."EarthquakeIngestionState" (
  "baselinedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastError" text,
  "lastFailureAt" timestamptz(3),
  "lastGeneratedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "lastModified" text,
  "lastSuccessAt" timestamptz(3),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "EarthquakeIngestionState_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."EarthquakeSubscription" (
  "channelId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "guildId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "locationName" text NOT NULL,
  "longitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "minMagnitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "radiusKm" float8 NOT NULL,
  "snowflake" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "EarthquakeSubscription_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."FeedbackBan" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "reason" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "FeedbackBan_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ForecastDestination" (
  "channelId" text NOT NULL,
  "guildId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "latitude" text NOT NULL,
  "longitude" text NOT NULL,
  "messageId" text NOT NULL,
  "radarImageUrl" text,
  "snowflake" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "ForecastDestination_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Incident" (
  "autoResolveAt" timestamptz(3),
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "resolvedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "severity" "IncidentSeverity" NOT NULL,
  "snowflake" text NOT NULL,
  "status" "IncidentStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"IncidentStatus" NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Incident_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."SentAlert" (
  "alertId" text NOT NULL,
  "channelId" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "guildId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "messageId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "SentAlert_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."VolatileMessage" (
  "channelId" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "guildId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "messageId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "VolatileMessage_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
